neighbours.label: ' waste' as the refuse noun in waste-reduction or recycling talk (zero waste, minimizing waste, waste disposal); 'waste' as a verb or in 'a waste of time' stays quiet
fire: Our office set a goal of sending zero waste to the landfill.
Composting kitchen scraps is a simple way of reducing waste at home.
The new packaging was designed to cut waste and save cardboard.
Shoppers who bring their own bags help keep waste out of the oceans.
The county expanded its recycling and waste collection program this spring.
Buying in bulk means less waste from wrappers and boxes.
The school teaches children to sort their waste into three bins.
Reusing glass jars is part of a low-waste lifestyle.
quiet: Our office set a goal of sending fewer emails over the weekend.
Arguing with him about it is a complete waste of time.
The new packaging was designed to catch the eye and sell more cereal.
Please do not waste the afternoon staring at your phone.
The county expanded its bus and bike lane program this spring.
Buying in bulk means lower prices on rice and beans.
The school teaches children to sort their crayons into three boxes.
He wasted his best chance when he missed the open goal.

notes: Card: ' waste' is the peak of 20 of the top 32. Probes: zero waste 0.90, minimizing waste 0.84, waste disposal 0.59, cut down on waste 0.56, Waste Management 0.43; but 'burns its waste' only 0.16, nuclear waste 0.06, 'a waste of time' 0.07, 'waste your money' 0.02. ' trash' in the same disposal slot reached 0.48, so the pole is partly the meaning, not only the token.
